features_info.title: Batteries and Controls Are Not Enabled Yet
features_info.description:
By default, only officially documented SolarEdge features are enabled: inverters, synergy inverters, and meters.

Battery monitoring and all read/write control features (battery control, site limit control) are based on documentation that SolarEdge does not publish. These are disabled by default and must be turned on separately from the integration's Configure options after this hub is added.

Not all inverters support these over Modbus. You may need to contact SolarEdge support to have battery and control access exposed on your installation.

setup_inverter_id_failed.title: Invalid Inverter Device ID
setup_inverter_id_failed.description: Inverter Device ID {device_id} at {host} is not responding or is not a valid SolarEdge inverter. It has been skipped. If the device was replaced or its ID changed, update the Inverter Device ID List in the hub configuration. Otherwise check the device and Modbus/TCP connection.

confirm.title: Global Dynamic Power Control Timeout
confirm.description:
Inverter Device ID {device_id} at {host} did not respond while reading data for Global Dynamic Power Controls after several attempts. These entities are unavailable until this is resolved.

Confirm to try detecting this feature again on the next poll. Disable the Auto-Detect Additional Entities option if the inverter has trouble trying to read these sensors.

confirm.title: Advanced Power Control Timeout
confirm.description:
Inverter Device ID {device_id} at {host} did not respond while reading data for Advanced Power Controls after several attempts. These entities are unavailable until this is resolved.

Confirm to try detecting this feature again on the next poll. Disable the Auto-Detect Additional Entities option if the inverter has trouble trying to read these sensors.

deprecated_yaml_modbus.description: The `modbus` section under `innovo_solar_edge` in `configuration.yaml` is no longer supported and is being ignored. Please remove it from your YAML configuration.

deprecated_keep_modbus_open.title: Keep Modbus Connection Open Option Replaced
deprecated_keep_modbus_open.description: The "Keep Modbus Connection Open" option has been replaced by "Close Connection After Polling" in this integration's configuration. Review the new option if you need the same behavior.

energy_array_settings.title: Enter the solar array details
energy_array_settings.description: Innovo Solar Edge uses placeholder values (10 x 400 W panels) for the solar array. Open the SolarEdge Energy device and set Solar Panel Count and Solar Panel Watts (and optionally tilt, azimuth and commissioning date) so the efficiency and typical-output metrics are correct. This notice clears once they are set.

energy_array_too_small.title: Solar panel settings are smaller than what the inverter measures
energy_array_too_small.description: The panels are set to {configured} kW, but the inverter has measured {measured} kW coming in from them. Panels can't deliver more than their rating, so the panel count or watts per panel must be too low. On a clear day the inverter usually sees no more than about 80% of the array rating, which puts this array at {minimum} kW or more. Check the optimizer count in the SolarEdge monitoring portal or SetApp (one optimizer per panel) and the panel model, then correct Solar Panel Count and Solar Panel Watts on the SolarEdge Energy device. Until then, typical output, efficiency and the cleaning indicator are wrong.

energy_array_too_large.title: Solar panel settings look too large for the inverter
energy_array_too_large.description: The panels are set to {configured} kW, more than twice the inverter's {inverter} kW rating. SolarEdge inverters are rarely paired with that much panel power. Check Solar Panel Count and Solar Panel Watts on the SolarEdge Energy device; a common mistake is entering the total array size as the watts per panel.

energy_location_missing.title: Set the home location for solar metrics
energy_location_missing.description: Home Assistant's home location is not set (latitude and longitude are 0). Innovo Solar Edge uses it for sunrise and sunset and for the typical-output lookup, so typical output and efficiency are wrong until it is set. Set it in Settings > System > General, then restart Home Assistant.
